title: Complete Contact Page Redesign + Functional Backend Form Integration

commits.body: Fully redesigned contacts.html into a new architecture combining modern design system tokens, updated typography scale, and refined layout structure. Replaced previous glassmorphism-heavy UI with a cleaner layered interface using a subtle grid background, simplified surface hierarchy, and improved color contrast system.

Rebuilt entire layout from a single contact-card based system into a two-column contact section separating informational metadata (identity, availability, email, GitHub) from a functional form-based interaction panel, improving structural clarity and user intent flow.

Added fully functional contact form integration using Web3Forms API with JSON-based submission via fetch, including bot protection field, subject injection, success/error state handling, and dynamic status messaging.
Introduced responsive navigation overhaul with mobile hamburger menu system, improved breakpoint handling, and full-screen nav collapse behavior for small screens.
Integrated Lenis smooth scrolling system and refined animation pipeline using IntersectionObserver-based reveal animations for key content blocks, replacing previous ad-hoc animation timing system.
Replaced previous contact cards (Telegram/Discord primary UI emphasis) with a more structured info-list system while retaining external links as secondary reference points in footer/social sections.
Added SEO and metadata improvements including meta description, author tag, and inline SVG favicon branding to improve identity consistency and search engine representation.
Refactored CSS into a more maintainable token-based system with improved variable naming consistency (bg/surface/border/text hierarchy) and reduced visual noise from overlapping effects.
